basics.name: Cristhian Quiñonez Chiriboga
basics.label: Front-End Developer
basics.summary: My name is Cristhian Quiñonez, and I’m a web developer based in Madrid. Two years ago, I began a strategic transition from the food industry to the tech sector, which has helped me develop strong adaptability and problem-solving skills. Specializing in web application development, my current focus is on building robust projects and seeking professional challenges that allow me to contribute technical value while continuing to grow as a developer.
